1.english_reference: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et factus est sermo Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

2.english_reference: Son of man , set thy face toward the south ,

traditions.WLC: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם שִׂ֤ים פָּנֶ֨י ךָ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ תֵּימָ֔נָ ה
traditions.LXX: Διὰ τοῦτο προφήτευσον , υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου , στήρισον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐπὶ Ἰερουσαλὴμ
traditions.VUL: Fili hóminis , pone fáciem tuam contra viam austri ,
traditions.KJV: Son of man , set thy face toward the south ,

2.english_reference: and drop [ thy word ] toward the south ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הַטֵּ֖ף אֶל דָּר֑וֹם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπίβλεψον ἐπὶ τὰ ἅγια αὐτῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et stilla ad áfricum ,
traditions.KJV: and drop [ thy word ] toward the south ,

2.english_reference: and prophesy against the forest of the south field ;

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנָּבֵ֛א אֶל יַ֥עַר הַ שָּׂדֶ֖ה נֶֽגֶב
traditions.LXX: καὶ προφητεύσεις ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: et prophéta ad saltum agri meridiáni .
traditions.KJV: and prophesy against the forest of the south field ;

3.english_reference: And say to the forest of the south , Hear the word of the LORD ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לְ יַ֣עַר הַ נֶּ֔גֶב שְׁמַ֖ע דְּבַר יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρεῖς πρὸς τὴν γῆν τοῦ Ἰσραήλ Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ πρὸς σέ ,
traditions.VUL: Et dices sáltui meridiáno : Audi verbum Dómini :
traditions.KJV: And say to the forest of the south , Hear the word of the LORD ;

traditions.WLC: כֹּֽה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֡ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκσπάσω τὸ ἐγχειρίδιόν μου ἐκ τοῦ κολεοῦ αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the Lord GOD ;

3.english_reference: Behold , I will kindle a fire in thee ,

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֣י מַֽצִּית בְּ ךָ֣ אֵ֡שׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξολεθρεύσω ἐκ σοῦ ἄδικον καὶ ἄνομον .
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego succéndam in te ignem ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , I will kindle a fire in thee ,

3.english_reference: and it shall devour every green tree in thee , and every dry tree :

traditions.WLC: וְ אָכְלָ֣ה בְ ךָ֣ כָל עֵֽץ לַח֩ וְ כָל עֵ֨ץ יָבֵ֤שׁ
traditions.VUL: et combúram in te omne lignum víride , et omne lignum áridum :
traditions.KJV: and it shall devour every green tree in thee , and every dry tree :

3.english_reference: the flaming flame shall not be quenched ,

traditions.WLC: לֹֽא תִכְבֶּה֙ לַהֶ֣בֶת שַׁלְהֶ֔בֶת
traditions.VUL: non exstinguétur flamma succensiónis :
traditions.KJV: the flaming flame shall not be quenched ,

3.english_reference: and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein .

traditions.WLC: וְ נִצְרְבוּ בָ֥ הּ כָּל פָּנִ֖ים מִ נֶּ֥גֶב צָפֽוֹנָ ה
traditions.VUL: et comburétur in ea omnis fácies ab austro usque ad aquilónem .
traditions.KJV: and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein .

4.english_reference: And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it :

traditions.WLC: וְ רָאוּ֙ כָּל בָּשָׂ֔ר כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בִּֽעַרְתִּ֑י
traditions.LXX: ἀνθ᾽ ὧν ἐξολεθρεύσω ἐκ σοῦ ἄδικον καὶ ἄνομον , οὕτως ἐξελεύσεται τὸ ἐγχειρίδιόν μου ἐκ τοῦ κολεοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πᾶσαν σάρκα ἀπὸ ἀπηλιώτου ἕως βορρᾶ ,
traditions.VUL: Et vidébit univérsa caro , quia ego Dóminus succéndi eam ,
traditions.KJV: And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it :

traditions.WLC: הָ לֹ֖א תִּכְבֶּֽה
traditions.VUL: nec exstinguétur .
traditions.KJV: it shall not be quenched .

5.english_reference: Then said I , Ah Lord GOD !

traditions.WLC: וָ אֹמַ֕ר אֲהָ֖הּ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπιγνώσεται πᾶσα σὰρξ διότι ἐγὼ Κύριος ἐξέσπασα τὸ ἐγχειρίδιόν μου ἐκ τοῦ κολεοῦ αὐτοῦ , οὐκ ἀποστρέψει οὐκέτι .
traditions.VUL: Et dixi : A a a , Dómine Deus :
traditions.KJV: Then said I , Ah Lord GOD !

5.english_reference: they say of me , Doth he not speak parables ?

traditions.WLC: הֵ֚מָּה אֹמְרִ֣ים לִ֔ י הֲ לֹ֛א מְמַשֵּׁ֥ל מְשָׁלִ֖ים הֽוּא
traditions.VUL: ipsi dicunt de me : Numquid non per parábolas lóquitur iste ?
traditions.KJV: they say of me , Doth he not speak parables ?

6.english_reference: And the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ σύ , υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου , καταστέναξον ἐν συντριβῇ ὀσφύος σου , καὶ ἐν ὀδύναις στενάξεις κατ᾽ ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: Et factus est sermo Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: And the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

7.english_reference: Son of man , set thy face toward Jerusalem ,

traditions.WLC: בֶּן אָדָ֗ם שִׂ֤ים פָּנֶ֨י ךָ֙ אֶל יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσται ἐὰν εἴπωσιν πρὸς σέ Ἕνεκα τίνος σὺ στενάζεις ; καὶ ἐρεῖς Ἐπὶ τῇ ἀγγελίᾳ διότι ἔρχεται , καὶ θραυσθήσεται πᾶσα καρδία , καὶ πᾶσαι χεῖρες παραλυθήσονται , καὶ ἐκψύξει πᾶσα σὰρξ καὶ πᾶν πνεῦμα , καὶ πάντες μηροὶ μολυνθήσονται ὑγρασίᾳ · ἰδοὺ ἔρχεται , λέγει κύριος Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: Fili hóminis pone fáciem tuam ad Ierúsalem ,
traditions.KJV: Son of man , set thy face toward Jerusalem ,

7.english_reference: and drop [ thy word ] toward the holy places ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הַטֵּ֖ף אֶל מִקְדָּשִׁ֑ים
traditions.VUL: et stilla ad sanctuária ,
traditions.KJV: and drop [ thy word ] toward the holy places ,

7.english_reference: and prophesy against the land of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.VUL: et prophéta contra humum Israel .
traditions.KJV: and prophesy against the land of Israel ,

8.english_reference: And say to the land of Israel , Thus saith the LORD ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַרְתָּ֞ לְ אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ λέγων .
traditions.VUL: Et dices terræ Israel : Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: And say to the land of Israel , Thus saith the LORD ;

8.english_reference: Behold , I [ am ] against thee , and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath ,

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֣י אֵלַ֔יִ ךְ וְ הוֹצֵאתִ֥י חַרְבִּ֖ י מִ תַּעְרָ֑ הּ
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego ad te , et eíciam gládium meum de vagína sua ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , I [ am ] against thee , and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath ,

8.english_reference: and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked .

traditions.WLC: וְ הִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֵּ֖ ךְ צַדִּ֥יק וְ רָשָֽׁע
traditions.VUL: et occídam in te iustum et ímpium .
traditions.KJV: and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked .

9.english_reference: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked ,

traditions.WLC: יַ֛עַן אֲשֶׁר הִכְרַ֥תִּי מִמֵּ֖ ךְ צַדִּ֣יק וְ רָשָׁ֑ע
traditions.LXX: Υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου , προφήτευσον καὶ ἐρεῖς Τάδε λέγει Κύριος Εἰπόν Ῥομφαία ῥομφαία , ὀξύνου καὶ θυμώθητι ,
traditions.VUL: Pro eo autem quod occídi in te iustum , et ímpium ,
traditions.KJV: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked ,

9.english_reference: therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north :

traditions.WLC: לָ֠ כֵן תֵּצֵ֨א חַרְבִּ֧ י מִ תַּעְרָ֛ הּ אֶל כָּל בָּשָׂ֖ר מִ נֶּ֥גֶב צָפֽוֹן
traditions.VUL: idcírco egrediétur gládius meus de vagína sua ad omnem carnem , ab austro usque ad aquilónem :
traditions.KJV: therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north :

10.english_reference: That all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath :

traditions.WLC: וְ יָֽדְעוּ֙ כָּל בָּשָׂ֔ר כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה הוֹצֵ֥אתִי חַרְבִּ֖ י מִ תַּעְרָ֑ הּ
traditions.LXX: ὅπως σφάξῃς σφάγια , ὀξύνου ὅπως γένῃ εἰς στίλβωσιν , ἑτοίμη εἰς παράλυσιν · σφάζε , ἐξουδένει , ἀπωθοῦ πᾶν ξύλον .
traditions.VUL: ut sciat omnis caro quia ego Dóminus , edúxi gládium meum de vagína sua
traditions.KJV: That all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath :

10.english_reference: it shall not return any more .

traditions.WLC: לֹ֥א תָשׁ֖וּב עֽוֹד
traditions.VUL: irrevocábilem .
traditions.KJV: it shall not return any more .

11.english_reference: Sigh therefore , thou son of man

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתָּ֥ה בֶן אָדָ֖ם הֵֽאָנַ֑ח
traditions.VUL: Et tu fili hóminis , ingemísce
traditions.KJV: Sigh therefore , thou son of man ,

11.english_reference: with the breaking of [ thy ] loins

traditions.WLC: בְּ שִׁבְר֤וֹן מָתְנַ֨יִם֙
traditions.VUL: in contritióne lumbórum ,
traditions.KJV: with the breaking of [ thy ] loins ;

11.english_reference: and with bitterness sigh before their eyes

traditions.WLC: וּ בִ מְרִיר֔וּת תֵּֽאָנַ֖ח לְ עֵינֵי הֶֽם
traditions.VUL: et in amaritudínibus ingemísce coram eis .
traditions.KJV: and with bitterness sigh before their eyes .

traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὴν ἑτοίμην τοῦ κρατεῖν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ · ἐξηκονήθη ἡ ῥομφαία , ἐστὶν ἑτοίμη τοῦ δοῦναι αὐτὴν εἰς χεῖρα ἀποκεντοῦντος .

12.english_reference: And it shall be , when they say unto thee , Wherefore sighest thou ?

traditions.WLC: וְ הָיָה֙ כִּֽי יֹאמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔י ךָ עַל מָ֖ה אַתָּ֣ה נֶאֱנָ֑ח
traditions.VUL: Cumque díxerint ad te : Quare tu gemis ?
traditions.KJV: And it shall be , when they say unto thee , Wherefore sighest thou ?

12.english_reference: that thou shalt answer , For the tidings ; because it cometh

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַרְתָּ֡ אֶל שְׁמוּעָ֣ה כִֽי בָאָ֡ה
traditions.VUL: dices : Pro audítu : quia venit ,
traditions.KJV: that thou shalt answer , For the tidings ; because it cometh :

traditions.WLC: וְ נָמֵ֣ס כָּל לֵב֩
traditions.VUL: et tabéscet omne cor ,
traditions.KJV: and every heart shall melt ,

12.english_reference: and all hands shall be feeble

traditions.WLC: וְ רָפ֨וּ כָל יָדַ֜יִם
traditions.VUL: et dissolvéntur univérsæ manus ,
traditions.KJV: and all hands shall be feeble ,

traditions.WLC: וְ כִהֲתָ֣ה כָל ר֗וּחַ
traditions.VUL: et infirmábitur omnis spíritus ,
traditions.KJV: and every spirit shall faint ,

12.english_reference: and all knees shall be weak [ as ] water

traditions.WLC: וְ כָל בִּרְכַּ֨יִם֙ תֵּלַ֣כְנָה מַּ֔יִם
traditions.VUL: et per cuncta génua fluent aquæ :
traditions.KJV: and all knees shall be weak [ as ] water :

12.english_reference: behold , it cometh , and shall be brought to pass , saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֤ה בָאָה֙ וְ נִֽהְיָ֔תָה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥ י יְהוִֽה
traditions.VUL: ecce venit , et fiet , ait Dóminus Deus .
traditions.KJV: behold , it cometh , and shall be brought to pass , saith the Lord GOD .

traditions.LXX: ἀνάκραγε καὶ ὀλόλυξον , υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου , ὅτι αὕτη ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ λαῷ μου , αὕτη ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἀφηγουμένοις τοῦ Ἰσραήλ · παροικήσουσιν , ἐπὶ ῥομφαίᾳ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ λαῷ μου · διὰ τοῦτο κρότησον ἐπὶ τὴν χεῖρά σου .

13.english_reference: Again the word of the LORD came unto me , saying

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.VUL: Et factus est sermo Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: Again the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.LXX: ὅτι δεδικαίωται · καὶ φυλὴ ἀπωσθῇ ; οὐκ ἔσται , λέγει κύριος Κύριος .

14.english_reference: Son of man , prophesy , and say , Thus saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הִנָּבֵא֙ וְ אָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֖ה אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֑ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ σύ , υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου , προφήτευσον καὶ κρότησον χεῖρα ἐπὶ χεῖρα
traditions.VUL: Fili hóminis prophéta , et dices : Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Son of man , prophesy , and say , Thus saith the LORD ;

14.english_reference: Say , A sword , a sword is sharpened , and also furbished

traditions.WLC: אֱמֹ֕ר חֶ֥רֶב חֶ֛רֶב הוּחַ֖דָּה וְ גַם מְרוּטָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ διπλασίασον ῥομφαίαν ·
traditions.VUL: Lóquere : Gládius , gládius exacútus est , et limátus .
traditions.KJV: Say , A sword , a sword is sharpened , and also furbished :

traditions.LXX: ἡ τρίτη ῥομφαία τραυματιῶν ἐστιν , ῥομφαία τραυματιῶν ἡ μεγάλη . καὶ ἐκστήσεις αὐτούς ,

15.english_reference: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter

traditions.WLC: לְמַ֨עַן טְבֹ֤חַ טֶ֨בַח֙ הוּחַ֔דָּה
traditions.LXX: ὅπως μὴ θραυσθῇ ἡ καρδία , καὶ πληθυνθῶσιν οἱ ἀσθενοῦντες ἐπὶ πᾶσαν πύλην ·
traditions.VUL: Ut cædat víctimas , exacútus est :
traditions.KJV: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter ;

15.english_reference: it is furbished that it may glitter

traditions.WLC: לְמַעַן הֱיֵה לָ֥ הּ בָּ֖רָק מֹרָ֑טָּה
traditions.LXX: παραδέδονται εἰς σφάγια ῥομφαίας , εὖ γέγονεν εἰς σφαγήν , εὖ γέγονεν εἰς στίλβωσιν .
traditions.VUL: ut spléndeat , limátus est :
traditions.KJV: it is furbished that it may glitter :

traditions.WLC: א֣וֹ נָשִׂ֔ישׂ
traditions.KJV: should we then make mirth ?

15.english_reference: it contemneth the rod of my son , [ as ] every tree .

traditions.WLC: שֵׁ֥בֶט בְּנִ֖ י מֹאֶ֥סֶת כָּל עֵֽץ
traditions.VUL: qui moves sceptrum fílii mei , succidísti omne lignum .
traditions.KJV: it contemneth the rod of my son , [ as ] every tree .

16.english_reference: And he hath given it to be furbished , that it may be handled

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛ הּ לְ מָרְטָ֖ה לִ תְפֹּ֣שׂ בַּ כָּ֑ף
traditions.VUL: Et dedi eum ad levigándum , ut teneátur manu :
traditions.KJV: And he hath given it to be furbished , that it may be handled :

16.english_reference: this sword is sharpened , and it is furbished

traditions.WLC: הִֽיא הוּחַ֤דָּה חֶ֨רֶב֙ וְ הִ֣יא מֹרָ֔טָּה
traditions.VUL: iste exacútus est gládius , et iste limátus est ,
traditions.KJV: this sword is sharpened , and it is furbished ,

16.english_reference: to give it into the hand of the slayer

traditions.WLC: לָ תֵ֥ת אוֹתָ֖ הּ בְּ יַד הוֹרֵֽג
traditions.VUL: ut sit in manu interficiéntis .
traditions.KJV: to give it into the hand of the slayer .

traditions.LXX: διαπορεύου , ὀξύνου ἐκ δεξιῶν καὶ ἐξ εὐωνύμων , οὗ ἂν τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἐξεγείρηται .

17.english_reference: Cry and howl , son of man

traditions.WLC: זְעַ֤ק וְ הֵילֵל֙ בֶּן אָדָ֔ם
traditions.VUL: Clama et úlula fili hóminis ,
traditions.KJV: Cry and howl , son of man :

traditions.WLC: כִּי הִיא֙ הָיתָ֣ה בְ עַמִּ֔ י הִ֖יא בְּ כָל נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.VUL: quia hic factus est in pópulo meo , hic in cunctis dúcibus Israel ,
traditions.KJV: for it shall be upon my people , it [ shall be ] upon all the princes of Israel :

17.english_reference: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people

traditions.WLC: מְגוּרֵ֤י אֶל חֶ֨רֶב֙ הָי֣וּ אֶת עַמִּ֔ י
